properties.description: Moderately easy hike to Sofea Jane Falls (Jeram Kubang Gajah) via ATV track. Waterfall area is raw, beautiful & very rocky with unusually large boulder forming a natural cave river. Picnic site is above the falls via short excursion route.
properties.name: Air Terjun Sofea Jane ATV Track

properties.name: Trail 13 (proposed)

properties.description: This "lost Trail 14 due to development" is finally rediscovered. Entrance and exit trailheads are now different. But the central original pathway is the same.
properties.name: Trail 14 Mentigi

properties.description: This is a moderate jungle route following Trail 9B paralleling Bertam river starting from Robinson hydropower plant and passing Maya and Robinson falls. It bypasses the notorious 9A trail. Waterfall swimming not recommended as water quality is poor.
properties.name: Trail 9 Oneway via 9B

properties.description: Easy nature walk between entrance and exit cafes passing by Butterfly Bank, scenic Langur Way Canopy Walk and panoramic Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk. Marketed for foreign tourists with overpriced admission fee.

properties.description: Easy hike to reservoir dam along paved road within Shah Alam National Botanical Gardens
properties.name: TBNSA: Laluan Pendakian Empangan Sungai Baru

properties.description: Easy-hike along paved road to durian, cempedak, rambutan orchards and more within Shah Alam National Botanical Gardens.
properties.name: TBNSA: Laluan Pendakian Taman Buah-Buahan

properties.description: Enjoy easy scenic hike along main features of the park: Paddy Fields, Fish Lake, model Kampung, Zingiberalace Garden, Spice Garden, swimming pool and Animal Garden with optional excursion to Air Kuning fishing reservoir.
properties.name: TBNSA: Pusingan Indah Fasiliti-fasiliti Utama

properties.description: Easy-moderate hike along paved road within rainforest park to the peak with disused observation tower. Ticket purchase required at park entrance.
properties.name: TBNSA: Laluan Pendakian Utama Bukit Sapu Tangan
properties.name:en: TBNSA: Sapu Tangan Hill Main Hiking Route

properties.description: Loop through Perdana Botanical Gardens scenic escapes via Sunken Garden, Canopy Plaza, lakeside trails and rainforest paths — spot deer, stroll orchid & hibiscus parks, and walk through the grand amphitheatre. Optional memorial excursion.
properties.name: Perdana Botanical Garden: Scenic walking loop via major features

properties.description: Main walking trail in Perdana Botanical Garden from Bukit Aman multi-storey car park round the lake.
properties.name: Perdana Botanical Garden: Main walking loop

properties.description: Moderate hike through dense rainforest to pristine waterfalls located within Lenteng Forest Reserve (permit needed)
properties.name: Ulu Tampik Falls Hiking Trail

properties.description: Moderately challenging hike beginning from Orang Asli plantations into Lenteng Forest Reserve (permit required) crossing 4 streams and the iconic big tree before arriving at the summit with views of Gunung Nuang.
properties.name: Bukit Repin Hiking Trail via Janda Baik

properties.description: Trailhead starts with river crossing into Janda Baik farmland, then entering Lenteng Forest Reserve (permit needed) and ascending steep climb to peak. Mini excursion to Luroh Falls.
properties.name: Gunung Nuang Hiking Trail via Janda Baik

properties.description: Hike along electrical grid trails to viewpoint to enjoy panaromic Damansara landscape and back via main road.
properties.name: Bukit Lanjan West Main Hiking Loop

properties.description: Moderately challenging hike along Bukit Tinggi countryside farms and forests to Tanglir Falls and nearby shrines.
properties.name: Tanglir Falls Hiking Trail

properties.description: Easy river trekking to gorgeous waterfall. Walk through culvert tunnel is surreal. Loop back along Karak Highway requires short climb up steep cliff and tricky climb down drain rungs.
properties.name: Pisang Falls Loop

properties.description: Start from Permatang Pasir mosque and hike through dense rainforest to disused army camp on top of the hill and descent via service road to lighthouse viewpoint with beautiful panaromic view of Sungai Langat Delta to end at Jugra Recreational Park
properties.name: Trans-Jugra Hiking Trail

properties.description: Thrilling adventure wading through river 5 times to arrive at Selangor's most majestic waterfall. The wading pool is a fish sanctuary where hundreds of fishes swarm all over your body. Online permit from Selangor Forestry Dept is mandatory.
properties.name: Chiling Fish Sanctuary & Waterfall Hike
